nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.forcesConvexPolygon_of_sweepExactUpperAt
nodes.description: A sweep-model exact upper bound at k transfers to the planar statement: every general-position set of 2^(k-2)+1 points contains a convex k-gon. Route: exists_sweptPresentation, apply h to P.configuration.tripleColoring, then SweptPresentation.containsConvexSubset_iff_exists_isStrongPolygonOn.
nodes.type_pp:
∀ (k : Nat),
  instLENat.le 3 k →
    ErdosSzekeres.SweepExactUpperAt k →
      ErdosSzekeres.ForcesConvexPolygon k (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub k 2)) 1)

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.sweepExactUpperAt_of_predecessorHalfSubset_all
nodes.description: Predecessor-half subsets at every level from 4 to k give the sweep-model exact upper bound at k. Route: Nat.le_induction from sweepExactUpperAt_three and sweepExactUpperAt_of_predecessorHalfSubset.
nodes.type_pp:
∀ (k : Nat),
  instLENat.le 3 k →
    (∀ (j : Nat), instLENat.le 4 j → instLENat.le j k → ErdosSzekeres.PredecessorHalfSubsetAt j) →
      ErdosSzekeres.SweepExactUpperAt k

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.decomposableStateUpper_all
nodes.description: The decomposable theorem (Baek–Balko Theorem 8) for all parameters: a decomposable coloring on more than decomposableThreshold a u k vertices contains an a-cap, a u-cup, or a strong k-set. The degenerate a = 1 / u = 1 cases are to be checked against containsCupSet_one before this statement is locked.

tags.dangling-ok: uniform theorem; consumer is E3FiniteReduction's DecomposableExactUpperAt

nodes.type_pp:
∀ (a u k : Nat),
  instLENat.le 1 a →
    instLENat.le 1 u →
      instLENat.le a k → instLENat.le u k → ErdosSzekeres.DecomposableStateUpper a u k

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.predecessorHalfSubsetAt_all
nodes.description: The predecessor-half conjecture: every sweep-realizable strong-k-free coloring has a support of the required size with no strong (k-1)-set. Falsified against the known extremal constructions (classical Erdős–Szekeres sets and Theorem-19 blow-ups) at k = 6, 7.

destinations.name: ErdosSzekeres.decomposableExactUpperAt_six
destinations.description:
The exact Erdős--Szekeres upper formula holds at `k = 6` throughout the

destinations.name: ErdosSzekeres.erdosSzekeresFormulaAt_five
destinations.description:
The happy-ending formula is exact at `n = 5`: nine points force a convex
pentagon, while eight points need not contain one.

destinations.name: ErdosSzekeres.erdosSzekeresFormulaAt_six
destinations.description:
The happy-ending formula is exact at `n = 6`: seventeen points force a
convex hexagon, while sixteen points need not contain one.

destinations.name: ErdosSzekeres.exists_predecessorHalfSubsetAtSix_of_card_le_fourteen
destinations.type_pp:
∀ {n : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n},
  ErdosSzekeres.IsSweepRealizable χ →
    Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ Finset.univ 6) →
      instLENat.le n 14 →
        Exists fun support =>
          And (Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ support 5))
            (instLENat.le n (instHMul.hMul 2 support.card))
destinations.description:
Through fourteen vertices, the elementary, Fin10, Fin11, and Fin13
predecessor theorems supply a half-sized strong-five-free support.

destinations.name: ErdosSzekeres.forces_six
destinations.description:
The kernel-checked seventeen-point upper bound for the happy-ending problem
at six vertices.

destinations.name: ErdosSzekeres.hmpt_explicit_upper
destinations.type_pp:
∀ (n : Nat),
  instLENat.le 3 n →
    ErdosSzekeres.ForcesConvexPolygon n
      (instHPow.hPow 2
        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd n (instHMul.hMul 32 (instHMul.hMul n (Nat.clog 2 n)).sqrt))
          128))
destinations.description: The explicit HMPT upper bound in published asymptotic form.

destinations.name: ErdosSzekeres.suk_explicit_upper
destinations.type_pp:
∀ (n : Nat),
  instLENat.le 65 n →
    ErdosSzekeres.ForcesConvexPolygon n
      (instHPow.hPow 2
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHAdd.hAdd n
            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 64 (instHPow.hPow (ErdosSzekeres.sukCubeScale n) 2))
              (Nat.clog 2 (instHMul.hMul 3 n))))
          128))
destinations.description: The frozen positive-fraction threshold is bounded by one explicit power.

destinations.name: ErdosSzekeres.tothValtr_upper
destinations.type_pp:
∀ (n : Nat),
  instLENat.le 3 n →
    ErdosSzekeres.ForcesConvexPolygon n
      (instHAdd.hAdd ((instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 n) 5).choose (instHSub.hSub n 2)) 2)
destinations.description:
The explicit Tóth--Valtr uniform upper bound for planar point sets in
general position.
